dict.string: Windfall opens the camera when you choose Take a photo, to add the picture to your journal or ask Eira what it shows.
Windfall turns what you say into text so you can talk to Eira and dictate records.
Windfall listens while you hold the talk button, so you can speak to Eira instead of typing.
Windfall adds a grid reference to your wildlife records and fetches local weather.
